perspective:
From the RECOMMENDER’s perspective:

- I greeted the seeker with “Good evening!”
- The seeker asked if there were any new movies worth watching.
- I asked what movie genres they were interested in.
- I said I thought *Bright* (2017) was really good, even without the back story.
- The seeker said they had never heard of *Bright*.
- I mentioned I also saw *Star Wars: Episode VIII – The Last Jedi* (2017).
- The seeker said they like all kinds of movies and will watch a kids movie followed by a horror flick.
- I told them *Bright* is a Netflix original starring Will Smith.
- The seeker then said something like “except for Star Wars, I’m not a fan... oh yeah I did see that, may have to watch that one.”
- I recommended *Coco* (2017) if they like animation or kids movies.
- The seeker said *Coco* was on their short list and they might watch it tonight.
